titleEn: How Long Does a Kitchen Renovation Take in Vancouver? Real Timelines for Every Scope (2026)
titleZh: 溫哥華廚房裝修需要多久？2026年各工程範圍的實際工期
contentEn:
For Vancouver homeowners, the most common question before a kitchen renovation is not "how much will it cost?" but "how long will it take?" The answer depends entirely on the scope of work — a minor cosmetic refresh can be complete in under three weeks, while a full layout-changing renovation with custom cabinetry can stretch across four months. Here is what every Metro Vancouver resident needs to know before signing a contract in 2026.

Minor Kitchen Refresh: 2–3 Weeks

A minor refresh means keeping every existing cabinet, plumbing line, and electrical circuit in place. Reno Stars has completed kitchen refreshes in North Vancouver and Richmond on this scope in 14–21 days. The work typically covers painting walls and cabinets, replacing faucets and sinks, installing a new cooktop or wall oven, and laying new flooring. No permit is required unless electrical circuit capacity is being increased, which is rare in a pure refresh. The final punch list and walkthrough happen on day 14 or 21.

Standard Kitchen Renovation: 4–6 Weeks

A standard renovation involves replacing all cabinet faces, installing new countertops, updating lighting fixtures, and possibly adding new electrical outlets or a new cooktop circuit. This is the most common scope Reno Stars handles in Vancouver and Surrey. Electrical and plumbing rough-ins are done in week one, cabinet installation follows in weeks two and three, and countertops — ordered in week one — are templated and installed in weeks three or four. The total timeline from demo to handover is typically four to six weeks.

Full Kitchen Renovation with Layout Changes: 7–12 Weeks

When walls are moved, a kitchen island is added, or the sink and stove positions are swapped, the project crosses into structural territory. In Richmond, Burnaby, and Vancouver, this scope requires a building permit and mandatory inspections at the rough-in, insulation, and final stages. Gas line relocations — needed when a gas cooktop moves to a different wall — add a separate permit and a BC Gas Safety inspection. Reno Stars budgeted eight to twelve weeks for a full layout renovation in a Richmond whole-house project completed in 2025, and seven to nine weeks for comparable work in Surrey.

Townhouse Renovation: 5–6 Months

Townhouse renovations in Burnaby and Coquitlam frequently involve strata approval in addition to municipal permits. Strata review adds two to four weeks to the pre-construction phase. Inside the home, the scope is often equivalent to a full kitchen renovation, but the exterior envelope and common wall considerations can extend electrical and insulation work. Reno Stars completed a premium townhouse kitchen renovation in Burnaby in five to six months, including strata sign-off and all inspections.

Permits, Inspections and BC Building Code in Vancouver (2026)

Under the BC Building Code 2024, any renovation that modifies structural elements, changes the use of a room, or alters electrical or plumbing systems requires a permit. A minor cosmetic refresh does not. In Vancouver, Burnaby, Richmond, Surrey, Coquitlam, and North Vancouver, the permit and inspection sequence is identical: apply, receive card (typically 5–10 business days for standard kitchen scopes), pass rough-in inspection, pass final inspection. Reno Stars manages permit applications as part of every renovation contract and has submitted over 60 permits across Metro Vancouver municipalities in the past three years.

Material Lead Times That Affect Your Timeline

Custom flat-pack or frameless cabinets from Vancouver suppliers require four to eight weeks of lead time after templating. Quartz and natural stone countertops require a template visit and then seven to ten business days for fabrication and installation. Imported designer tile — common in luxury renovations in West Vancouver and Vancouver proper — can require three to six weeks for delivery. Reno Stars orders all long-lead items in week one of every renovation so that material delays never become schedule surprises.

Frequently Asked Questions

How long does a minor kitchen refresh take in Vancouver?

A minor kitchen refresh in Vancouver — painting cabinets, replacing the faucet and sink, updating lighting, and laying new flooring — typically takes two to three weeks. No building permit is required unless electrical circuits are being added or upgraded. Reno Stars has completed this scope in North Vancouver and Richmond within 14 to 21 days.

Does a kitchen renovation in Vancouver require a permit?

Under the BC Building Code 2024, a permit is required whenever electrical circuits, plumbing lines, or structural elements are modified. A cosmetic refresh that only replaces surfaces does not need a permit. A full renovation that moves the sink, cooktop, or any electrical circuit definitely does. Reno Stars handles the permit application and schedules all mandatory inspections as part of every renovation contract.

What is the longest phase of a kitchen renovation?

Custom cabinet fabrication is typically the longest single phase, requiring four to eight weeks of lead time after the initial template is taken. Countertop templating and fabrication adds another seven to ten business days. Reno Stars orders all long-lead items in week one of every project so that material delivery never becomes the critical path bottleneck.

How does a townhouse renovation timeline differ from a single-family home?

In Metro Vancouver, townhouse renovations require strata approval in addition to the standard municipal building permit. Strata review can add two to four weeks to the pre-construction phase. Reno Stars has managed townhouse renovations in Burnaby and Coquitlam where strata sign-off was required before any interior work began.

Can weather delay a kitchen renovation in Vancouver?

Vancouver's rainy season (October through March) does not directly delay interior renovation work, but it can affect projects that involve exterior envelope work, balcony modifications, or any stage where walls are open to the outside. For a standard interior kitchen renovation, weather is not a meaningful schedule factor in Metro Vancouver.

對溫哥華的業主來說，廚房裝修前最常問的問題不是「要多少錢」，而是「需要多久」？答案取決於工程範圍——輕度美容更新可在三週內完工，而涉及格局改動和訂造櫥櫃的全面翻新可能長達四個月。以下是2026年每位大溫業主在簽約前需要知道的資訊。

輕度廚房更新：2–3週

輕度更新指保留所有現有櫥櫃、管道和電路，只做表面施工。聚星裝修在北溫和列治文完成的廚房更新工程，工期為14至21天。工作通常包括牆面和櫥櫃刷漆、龍頭和水槽更換，安裝新煮食爐或嵌入式烤箱，以及鋪設新地板。電路容量不增加的情況下無需許可證，純美容更新很少涉及電路改動。最終驗收清單和移交在第14天或第21天完成。

標準廚房翻新：4–6週

標準翻新涉及更換所有櫥櫃門板，安裝新檯面、更新照明裝置，並可能新增電插座或新煮食爐電路。這是聚星裝修在溫哥華和素里最常見的工程範圍。水電管線毛坯工程在第一週完成，櫥櫃安裝在第二和三週跟進，櫃檯面在第一週下單後，於第三或第四週測量並安裝。從拆遷到移交的總工期通常為四至六週。

格局改動的全面廚房翻新：7–12週

當需要拆牆，加設廚房島台，或移動水槽和爐具位置時，工程便進入結構工程範疇。在列治文、本拿比和溫哥華，此工程範圍需要建築許可證，並在水電管線吊頂、保溫和最終階段進行強制檢查。燃氣管道改位——當燃氣煮食爐移至另一面牆時需要——需另行申請許可證，並須通過BC燃氣安全檢查。聚星裝修在2025年完成的列治文全面翻新工程預算工期為8至12週，素里類似工程為7至9週。

城市屋苑翻新：5–6個月

本拿比和高貴林的城市屋苑翻新除市政建築許可證外，還需要管委會批准。管委會審查會使施工前期增加兩至四週時間。室內工程範圍通常相當於全面廚房翻新，但外牆和共有牆壁的處理可能延長水電和保溫工程。聚星裝修在本拿比完成的城市屋苑豪華裝修工程，包括管委會審批和所有檢查，工期為五至六個月。

許可證、檢查和BC建築規範（2026年）

根據BC建築規範2024版，任何涉及結構修改、改變房間用途或改動水電系統的翻新工程均需申請許可證。純美容更新無需許可證。在溫哥華、本拿比、列治文，素里，高貴林和北溫，許可證和檢查流程相同：申請、領取許可證卡（標準廚房翻新通常5至10個工作日），通過水電吊頂檢查、通過最終檢查。聚星裝修將許可證申請作為每份裝修合約的一部分，在過去三年已在大溫各市政區提交超過60份許可證。

影響工期的材料備貨時間

溫哥華供應商的訂造平板櫥櫃或無框櫥櫃，在測量後通常需要四至八週備貨時間。石英石和天然石材檯面需要上門測量後，再預留七至十個工作日製作和安裝。進口設計瓷磚——在西溫和溫哥華豪華翻新中常見——送貨可能需要三至六週。聚星裝修在每個工程的第一週即下單所有備貨時間較長的材料，確保材料延誤不會成為工期瓶頸。

常見問題

溫哥華輕度廚房更新需要多久？

溫哥華輕度廚房更新——包括櫥櫃刷漆、龍頭和水槽更換、照明更新和地板鋪設——通常需要兩至三週。除非需要新增或升級電路，否則無需建築許可證。聚星裝修曾在北溫和列治文以14至21天完成此工程範圍。

溫哥華廚房翻新需要許可證嗎？

根據BC建築規範2024版，任何涉及電路、管道或結構修改的工程均需許可證。僅更換表面的純美容翻新無需許可證。涉及移動水槽、煮食爐或任何電路的全面翻新則必須申請許可證。聚星裝修在每份裝修合約中代為處理許可證申請並安排所有強制檢查。

廚房翻新中最耗時的階段是什麼？

訂造櫥櫃通常是最耗時的單一階段，測量後通常需要四至八週備貨時間。石材檯面的測量和製作另需七至十個工作日。聚星裝修在每個工程第一週即下單所有長備貨材料，確保材料到貨時間不影響整體工期。

城市屋苑翻新的工期與獨立屋有何不同？

在大溫哥華，城市屋苑翻新除標準市政建築許可證外，還需要管委會批准。管委會審查可使施工前期增加兩至四週。聚星裝修曾在 本拿比和高貴林管理需要管委會批准的城市屋苑工程，在任何室內工程開始前必須獲得管委會書面批准。

天氣會延誤溫哥華的廚房翻新嗎？

溫哥華的雨季（10月至3月）不會直接延誤室內裝修工程，但可能影響涉及外牆、陽台改建或牆壁外露的工程階段。對於標準室內廚房翻新而言，大溫的天氣不是重要的工期因素。
